project.title: Bacterioplankton in a recreational lake with reclaimed water Targeted Locus (Loci)
project.description: This study is aimed to elucidate the effects of reclaimed water on bacterial community composition and potential human pathogens in a recreational lake in Beijing.
project.center_name: State Key Joint Laboratory on Environment Simulation and Pollution Control
